newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Heavy to make fuel-efficient marine engine.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Heavy to make fuel-efficient marine engine.

text.p: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd said on Thursday it has started to develop a new fuel-efficient marine diesel engine.

The engine, the UEC52LSE, requires only 123 grams of oil fuel to produce one horsepower per hour, compared with the existing model which consumes 126 grams of fuel to produce the same amount of power, a company spokesman said.
The company will be able to supply the new engines to customers in one to two years from now, the spokesman said.
